[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided sugar-free cocktail ideas, including a Stevia Spritz with Grapefruit Bitters, Erythritol Old Fashioned with Orange Bitters, Monk Fruit Mojito with Lime Bitters, Yacon Syrup Sour with Cherry Bitters, and Xylitol Collins with Cucumber Bitters.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant described yacon syrup as a low-calorie sweetener made from the root of the yacon plant, containing fructooligosaccharides.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided characteristics of yacon syrup, noting it is 1/3 to 1/2 as sweet as sugar.
